newsitem.title: UK: Bowthorpe firm after full-year figures.
newsitem.headline: Bowthorpe firm after full-year figures.

text.p: Shares in Bowthorpe Plc were up 17-1/2p to 406p by 1010 GMT after the company reported a six percent drop in full-year pre-tax profits to 72.9 million stg from 77.46 million stg.
Analysts said the headline figure was hit by the impact of a strong pound as well as restructuring costs.
"When you bear in mind the currency cost and the cost of restructuring, the underlying business is growing at about eight to ten percent," said Mark Stiles, analyst at Credit Lyonnais Laing.
"Having seen the share price underperform over the past few months, it's no surprise to see the bounce we've seen today."
Since January 1, Bowthorpe shares have underperformed the FTSE All Share index by around 19 percent, according to Reuters Securities 3000.
